   310	  // Deep freeze using captured Object.freeze + captured getOwnPropertyNames.
   311	  function _deepFreeze(v) {
   312	    if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
   313	    try { _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(v); } catch (e) { /* swallow */ }
   314	    var keys;
   315	    try { keys = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(v); } catch (e) { return v; }
   316	    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
   317	      var k = keys[i];
   318	      var child;
   319	      try { child = v[k]; } catch (eGet) { continue; }
   320	      _deepFreeze(child);
   321	    }
   322	    return v;
   323	  }

   325	  // ---------- Input descriptor snapshot --------------------------------------------------------
   326	  // Mirrors D5 snapshotInputDescriptors: walks own descriptors (NOT [[Get]]) so a Proxy with
   327	  // hostile getters does NOT fire on first read. Symbol / non-enumerable / accessor / unknown
   328	  // own key → reject before any further inspection.
   329	  function _snapshotPlainShape(o, allowedKeys, invalidCode, opts) {
   330	    opts = opts || {};
   331	    if (!_isOriginalPlainObject(o)) {
   332	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.PROTOTYPE_POLLUTION_REJECTED], detail: 'not plain' };
   333	    }
   334	    if (opts.requireFrozen && _isFrozenSafe(o) !== true) {
   335	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'not frozen' };
   336	    }
   337	    if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(o)) {
   338	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'symbol own key' };
   339	    }
   340	    var names;
   341	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(o); } catch (e) {
   342	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'descriptor read failed' };
   343	    }
   344	    var snap = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_CREATE(null);
   345	    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
   346	      var k = names[i];
   347	      // Reject unknown own key — caller cannot smuggle `class`, `outcomeId`, `confounders`,
   348	      // etc. into the input wrapper.
   349	      if (allowedKeys.indexOf(k) === -1) {
   350	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'unknown own key ' + k };
   351	      }
   352	      var d;
   353	      try { d = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(o, k); } catch (e) {
   354	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'descriptor inaccessible' };
   355	      }
   356	      if (!d || d.enumerable !== true) {
   357	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable key ' + k };
   358	      }
   359	      if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') {
   360	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor key ' + k };
   361	      }
   362	      snap[k] = d.value;
   363	    }
   364	    return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   365	  }
   366	
   367	  // Codex E3-R1-03 closure: dense-array enforcement. Reject sparse arrays (any index in
   368	  // 0..length-1 missing an enumerable data descriptor → hole) AND reject any own key
   369	  // other than 'length' or a canonical numeric index (no Symbol keys, no string names,
   370	  // no negative / fractional / leading-zero indices). The walk indexes BY index, not by
   371	  // getOwnPropertyNames enumeration order, so a hostile array that puts named own keys
   372	  // first cannot smuggle a hole past the cap check.
   373	  function _snapshotArrayShape(a, invalidCode) {
   374	    if (!_isPlainArray(a)) {
   375	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'not array' };
   376	    }
   377	    if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(a)) {
   378	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'symbol own key on array' };
   379	    }
   380	    var aLen;
   381	    try { aLen = a.length; } catch (e) {
   382	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array length inaccessible' };
   383	    }
   384	    if (typeof aLen !== 'number' || !_CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_INTEGER(aLen) || aLen < 0 || aLen > ARRAY_CAP) {
   385	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.ARRAY_CAP_EXCEEDED], detail: 'array len ' + aLen };
   386	    }
   387	    // First sweep: enumerate own keys and reject ANY name other than 'length' or a
   388	    // canonical numeric index in [0, aLen). Reject Symbol keys (already above), reject
   389	    // non-enumerable / accessor / non-data descriptors on indices.
   390	    var names;
   391	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(a); } catch (e) {
   392	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array desc inaccessible' };
   393	    }
   394	    for (var ni = 0; ni < names.length; ni++) {
   395	      var nm = names[ni];
   396	      if (nm === 'length') continue;
   397	      if (!ARRAY_INDEX_RE.test(nm)) {
   398	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'non-index own key on array: ' + nm };
   399	      }
   400	      var idxN = +nm;
   401	      if (idxN < 0 || idxN >= aLen) {
   402	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array index out of [0,length): ' + nm };
   403	      }
   404	      var dn;
   405	      try { dn = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(a, nm); } catch (e) {
   406	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array elt desc fail' };
   407	      }
   408	      if (!dn || dn.enumerable !== true) {
   409	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable array elt at ' + nm };
   410	      }
   411	      if (typeof dn.get === 'function' || typeof dn.set === 'function') {
   412	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor array elt at ' + nm };
   413	      }
   414	    }
   415	    // Second sweep: walk by index 0..aLen-1. Every index MUST have an OWN enumerable
   416	    // data descriptor (no holes, no prototype-inherited values).
   417	    var snap = [];
   418	    for (var i = 0; i < aLen; i++) {
   419	      var key = '' + i;
   420	      var d;
   421	      try { d = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(a, key); } catch (e) {
   422	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array elt desc fail at ' + i };
   423	      }
   424	      if (!d) {
   425	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'sparse array hole at index ' + i };
   426	      }
   427	      if (d.enumerable !== true) {
   428	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable array elt at ' + i };
   429	      }
   430	      if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') {
   431	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor array elt at ' + i };
   432	      }
   433	      snap.push(d.value);
   434	    }
   435	    return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   436	  }

   439	    var snap = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_CREATE(null);
   440	    if (optsIn === undefined || optsIn === null) return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   441	    var r = _snapshotPlainShape(optsIn, OPTS_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   442	    if (r.valid !== true) return r;
   443	    // Type-check each opt.
   444	    if (r.snapshot.clock !== undefined && r.snapshot.clock !== null && typeof r.snapshot.clock !== 'function') {
   445	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], detail: 'opts.clock not function' };
   446	    }
   447	    if (r.snapshot.referenceNowMs !== undefined && r.snapshot.referenceNowMs !== null

   453	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], detail: 'opts.maxAgeMs invalid' };
   454	    }

   458	  // ---------- Deterministic ID generator -------------------------------------------------------
   459	  // outcomeId is deterministic from (experimentId, changeId). No clock leak.
   460	  function _hash32(s) {
   461	    var h = 0x811c9dc5;
   462	    var len = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   463	    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
   464	      h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);
   465	      h = (h + ((h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24))) >>> 0;
   466	    }
   467	    return h.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
   468	  }
   469	  function _fnv2(s) {
   470	    var slen = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   471	    return _hash32(s) + _hash32(s + '|' + slen);
   472	  }
   473	  function _outcomeId(experimentId, changeId) {
   474	    return 'outcome_' + _fnv2('outcome|' + experimentId + '|' + changeId);
   475	  }
   476	
   477	  // ---------- Main entry: classifyOutcome -----------------------------------------------------
   478	  /**
   479	   * classifyOutcome(input, opts) — produces a deep-frozen Outcome envelope.
   480	   *
   481	   * Ordered steps (clock MUST NOT fire before Step 9):
   482	   *   0.  intrinsic integrity (captures + contract surfaces still frozen)
   483	   *   1.  input wrapper descriptor snapshot (closed keys; symbol/accessor/proxy rejected)
   484	   *   2.  experiment frozen + E1 shape validation
   485	   *   3.  appliedChange snapshot + shape
   486	   *   4.  followUp snapshot + shape
   487	   *   5.  observation snapshot + shape
   488	   *   6.  controlVariableObservations snapshot + per-element E1 shape
   489	   *   7.  opts snapshot
   490	   *   8.  identity binding (status=applied, sourceExperimentId match, parentCaseId match)
   491	   *   9.  resolve freshness reference time (clock at most once)
   492	   *   10. freshness check on experiment.createdAt + appliedChange.appliedAt
   493	   *   11. comparison-validity computation (invalid_comparison precedence)
   494	   *   12. control-variable integrity (inconclusive_due_to_confounders precedence)
   495	   *   13. data-quality + direction/magnitude classification cascade
   496	   *   14. compose outcome
   497	   *   15. validate via E1 OUT.validateOutcomeShape
   498	   *   16. envelope byte cap
   499	   *   17. deep-freeze + register
   500	   */
   501	  function classifyOutcome(inputIn, optsIn) {
   502	    try {
   503	      // ---- Step 0: intrinsic integrity ----------------------------------------------------
   504	      if (!_intrinsicsIntact()) {
   505	        return _buildTamperBlock('intrinsic tampering detected at entry');
   506	      }
   507	
   508	      // ---- Step 1: input wrapper descriptor snapshot -------------------------------------
   509	      var inSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputIn, INPUT_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, { requireFrozen: false });

    35	function deepFreeze(v) {
    36	  if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
    37	  Object.freeze(v);
    38	  var names = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(v);
    39	  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) deepFreeze(v[names[i]]);
    40	  return v;
    41	}

   682	        }

   687	      var optsR = _snapshotOpts(optsIn);

   690	      }
   691	      var optsSnap = optsR.snapshot;
   692	
   693	      // ---- Step 8: identity binding -------------------------------------------------------
   694	      if (experiment.status !== 'applied') {
   695	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.EXPERIMENT_STATUS_INVALID], { detail: 'experiment.status must be applied to classify, got ' + experiment.status });
   696	      }
   697	      if (experiment.outcome !== null) {
   698	        // Defence-in-depth: E1 contract already enforces outcome=null for status=applied,

   701	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'caller-supplied experiment.outcome forbidden at classification' });

   705	      }

   708	      var crossCase = (followUp.parentCaseId !== experiment.sourceCaseId);

   721	        if (typeof clockIso === 'string' && clockIso.length > 0) {

   725	            resolvedClockIso = clockIso;
   726	          }

   728	      }
   729	      if (typeof refNowMs !== 'number' || refNowMs !== refNowMs) {
   730	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'unable to resolve reference time (opts.clock missing or invalid)' });
   731	      }

   736	      var changeAppliedMs = _isoToMs(appliedChange.appliedAt);
   737	      if (expCreatedMs !== null && (refNowMs - expCreatedMs) > maxAgeMs) {
   738	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'experiment exceeds max age' });
   739	      }
   740	      if (changeAppliedMs !== null && (refNowMs - changeAppliedMs) > maxAgeMs) {

   744	      // ---- Step 11: comparison-validity computation (invalid_comparison precedence) ------

   749	      if (crossCase || crossSession || noExplicitReference || lowComparability) {

   752	        if (crossSession) limitations.push(CODES.LIMITATION_CROSS_SESSION_FOLLOW_UP);

   822	            // direction match (the contradicting evidence is itself evidence to the contrary).
   823	            classDecision = 'contradicted';
   824	          } else if (!directionMatch) {
   825	            classDecision = 'contradicted';
   826	          } else if (magnitudeInRange) {

   828	          } else {

   832	      }
   833	
   834	      // ---- Step 14: compose outcome ------------------------------------------------------

   846	        experimentId: experiment.experimentId,

   859	      // ---- Step 15: validate via E1 OUT.validateOutcomeShape -----------------------------

   884	
   885	    } catch (eOuter) {
   886	      return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION], { detail: 'classifyOutcome threw on hostile input' });
   887	    }
   888	  }
   889	
   890	  // ---------- Public API ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   891	  var api = {
   892	    SERVICE_VERSION: SERVICE_VERSION,
   893	    OUTCOME_SCHEMA_VERSION: OUTCOME_SCHEMA_VERSION,
   894	    ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP: ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP,
